assertions.check: Explicitly confirms or denies buildability with the stated stack (Next.js, Django Ninja Extra, Postgres, Expo)
Lists the top 3 hardest technical challenges with severity assessment
MVP effort estimate is in sprints with stated sprint length and team assumptions
Third-party dependencies are listed with risk level (API stability, pricing, alternatives)
Identifies any features that would require technology outside the standard stack
Scope estimate is consistent with the validation report's feature description

meta_assertion: Could an engineering lead read this and start sprint planning without further research?
test_prompt: Assess technical feasibility for a deployment automation SaaS using Next.js + Django Ninja Extra + Postgres.
